messages:
Maya K: Heads-up — noticed the SDK telemetry decision tree is bumping multiple counters for the same request. Console shows inflated client-side metrics.
Raj P: Can you paste a repro or minimal request?
Maya K: Sure. Happens when route negotiation + fallback logic both emit events. Minimal headers:
```json
{
  "X-Redwood-Route": "r1",
  "X-Redwood-Request-Id": "req-1234",
  "X-Redwood-Route-Fallback": "r1-fallback"
}
```
Maya K: Both route and fallback handlers call meter.increment('client.requests') independently.
Lin C: I saw the same during the internal proxy handoff last week. Proxy emits a route attribute and SDK emits one too.
Jordan G: That matches a recent change I made to sampling: default was moved from client->middleware, so now two components claim ownership.
Oli (PM): What's user impact? Are dashboards unusable or just noisy?
Maya K: Mostly noisy. Alert thresholds triggered for a few tenants. We need dedup or a single source of truth.
Alex S: Quick mitigation: dedupe in the console ingestion by (tenant, request_id, metric_name) for 30s window. Cheap to apply but hides root cause.
Raj P: Prefer fixing SDK to avoid server-side hacks. Can we add a dedupe key emitted by SDK? e.g., `sampling_key = route||request_id`
Jordan G: We can add X-Redwood-Telemetry-Key header from SDK. If present, middlewares should skip emitting the same metric.
Maya K: Example change in Python SDK (pseudo):
```python
key = f"{route}:{request_id}"
headers['X-Redwood-Telemetry-Key'] = key
# middleware: if seen_keys.contains(key): return
```
Lin C: TS/Go SDKs will need equivalent. This is a small breaking surface but low risk.
Oli (PM): Timeline? We should canary the change and coordinate console dashboards so alerts don't flail.
Raj P: Plan: 1) SDK PRs add header and opt-in flag (default on), 2) Console ingestion patch to dedupe for 2 weeks as safety, 3) Canary rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h.
Maya K: I'll open Python PR and include opt-out env var: REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY=0 to disable header emission.
Jordan G: I'll do TS PR and add unit test asserting header present when routing is enabled.
Alex S: I'll queue the console dedupe change. We'll keep dedupe short-lived, rollback if any tenant reports missing metrics.
Oli (PM): Add a console note and slack alert to paging policy owners during canary. Also update runbook.
Raj P: For rollout commands, we'll use release bot: `/release canary sdk 10% reason:telemetry-dedupe`
Maya K: Any objections to default being ON?
Lin C: Default ON is fine as long as we have opt-out and clear changelog.
Jordan G: Agreed. I'll coordinate release PRs and include migration notes for integrators.
telemetry-bot: Alert: console-ingestion spike detected at 2026-03-20T15:42Z — correlated to increased client.requests counts. :eyes:
Alex S: notch: I'll watch spikes during the canary and post updates here.
Maya K: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/1428 — includes header + tests.
Raj P: Thanks. Put review label `telemetry-hotfix` and we can merge after +1 from eng-platform.
Oli (PM): I'll draft the console dashboard note and notify customers if anything noisy shows up.
Maya K: 👍 starting canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Jordan G: I'll schedule TS and Go PRs to land in the same window.
Alex S: Monitoring playbook: watch `client.requests` by tenant, filter by request_id duplication rates. If >1% duplicates, pause rollout.
Maya K: Cool — will post rollout status here. :rocket:
